entities.name: Qala
entities.description: Nacatl leonin of Alara and former tribemate of Ajani and Jazal Goldmane, who abandoned Ajani to human hunters.

entities.name: Tenoch
entities.description: Nacatl leonin who patrolled with Qala and Ajani and abandoned Ajani with Qala.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: Planeswalker, white-furred leonin whom Qala and Tenoch called jinxed.

entities.name: Jazal Goldmane
entities.description: Ajani's brother and kha of the Nacatl tribe.

entities.name: Nacatl
entities.description: The leonin tribe of Qala, Tenoch, Ajani and Jazal.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: Shard of Alara where leonin and humans are usually not hostile.

events.summary: Qala and Tenoch are assigned to patrol with Ajani, and protest that he is jinxed; Jazal's word as kha is final.
events.quote: But Ajani's brother Jazal Goldmane was the kha of their tribe, and his word was final.

events.summary: Human hunters attack the patrol to claim Ajani's white hide, and Qala and Tenoch stay behind, abandoning Ajani to his fate.
events.quote: Tenoch and Qala stayed behind, abandoning Ajani to his fate.

relations.note: Jazal is the kha of the tribe.
relations.quote: Jazal Goldmane was the kha of their tribe
